scope: specification-only math; not native dynamics, assets, synchronization or acceptance
continuous_bound: Orthogonal Rx/Ry/B preserve Euclidean norm; max corner norm bounds every point of the convex occupied box for every combined trajectory. Does not bound yaw-deck forks/spindle/bogie: those need their own authored geometry and native sweep.
limits: Reference rate bounds assume constant travel speed. Native rate/acceleration, loading/solver response, endpoint lock dwell, blends, drive holds, marker validity and actual clearances remain required.
